newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH NBP UPS 7, 14-DAY REVERSE REPO RATES.
newsitem.headline: POLISH NBP UPS 7, 14-DAY REVERSE REPO RATES.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland increased the maximum rate at its benchmark 14-day reverse repo to 23.55 percent from the previous 23.00 percent on July 29, the central bank said.
The central bank also increased the maximum 7-day reverse repo rate to 23.45 percent from 22.89 percent on July 25.
The average 14-day reverse repo rate was 23.53 percent and the average 7-day rate was 23.40 percent.
Polish banks bid to place 345 million zlotys for seven days and 128 million for 14 days. The central bank drained 335 million for seven days and 39 million for 14 days. @
